column1: # mapping_set_description: The business plugin's terms (each from a picked model) mapped to the terms of the other models searched (docs/choices/business-vocabulary.yaml)

column8: comment
both: an organized group with its own identity
Valueflows' agent that is an organization
a BPMN pool is often one organization in a collaboration
schema.org has no unit class; a unit is an Organization with a parentOrganization
schema:Role qualifies a relation (with dates), not a position in an organization
a lane usually stands for the role that does its activities
BPMN's resource role that performs an activity
BMM's resource is a means the enterprise has
a product is one kind of resource
an OCEL object may be a resource; it may also be a document or a case
Valueflows: the kind of process; vf:Process is one run of it
OCEL's event type is the activity an event is an occurrence of
schema:Action is one action done, not the step a process names
an action performed by an agent, with a start and end time
an economic event is one kind of event: one that moves a resource
BPMN's event is a node in a model; OCEL's is something that happened
the task that invokes a decision
a business rule may be the logic a decision applies
a digital document is one kind of document
the data a process reads or writes, drawn as a document
vf:Measure is a quantity with a unit, not a defined metric
a BMM objective is a measurable target, which a measure tracks
an objective quantifies a goal
a Valueflows intent is a wanted flow, not a state of the enterprise
ORG's holds is to a post; a role here is held directly
a sequence flow, as a relation from its source to its target
OCEL's qualified event-to-object relation
